I chose 1214 as the first-floor interior figure, but the cell is split by floor, so which one is meant is a judgment call. The 3959 total counts both (845+1214+985+915).

Unit 2 and Unit 3 outdoor/limited square footage are sums of two components each (T+R); reported as the sum since no single figure given (236+351=587; 70+509=579) — flagged as these are computed sums, not printed single numbers.
